name: Disease Product Causal Feedback Blockade (Full Descendant Control)
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when The disease produces the molecular gene product The pinned descendant closure is biolink:produces. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.; Chemical causally affects gene in the decreased direction for activity, activity_or_abundance The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.; The downstream gene causes or contributes to the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes, biolink:contributes_to. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.
hypothesis: A disease-produced molecule that also causes or contributes to that disease forms a candidate positive-feedback loop.

edges.subject: disease
edges.explanation: The disease produces the molecular gene product The pinned descendant closure is biolink:produces. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.

edges.subject: chemical
edges.explanation: Chemical causally affects gene in the decreased direction for activity, activity_or_abundance The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.

edges.subject: gene
edges.explanation: The downstream gene causes or contributes to the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:causes, biolink:contributes_to. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.

mechanism.rationale: A disease-produced molecule that also causes or contributes to that disease forms a candidate positive-feedback loop. The graph pattern is a hypothesis, not proof of clinical efficacy.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (disease:Disease)-[production:{{relationship_types:production}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE production.predicate IN {{predicates:production}} MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[target:{{relationship_types:target}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE target.predicate IN {{predicates:target}} AND target.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND target.object_direction_qualifier = "decreased" AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["activity","activity_or_abundance"] AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl","infores:gtopdb","infores:drugcentral"] WHERE source IN coalesce(target.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[causal:{{relationship_types:causal}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE causal.predicate IN {{predicates:causal}} RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: target: enforce primary-source membership in infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, infores:drugcentral

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Source assertions lack dose, exposure, clinical context, and experimental causal validation.
The full affects closure includes ameliorates_condition and is classified as treatment-using even if no such edge satisfies the other constraints in this graph.
